judgeLog.raw:
PLAN A: CAUSAL 9 CHRONOLOGY 7 PLAUSIBILITY 6 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 9 SUITABILITY 8 CONTRADICTION yes OVERALL 6 — Minor chronology error (mom in kitchen then suddenly at balcony door without transition) and weak plausibility (spilling a whole quilt while wiping a spot)
PLAN B: CAUSAL 9 CHRONOLOGY 9 PLAUSIBILITY 10 SIMPLICITY 10 TARGETFIT 9 SUITABILITY 9 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 9 — Tight, logical flow with natural target word usage and zero plot holes
PLAN C: CAUSAL 7 CHRONOLOGY 6 PLAUSIBILITY 5 SIMPLICITY 8 TARGETFIT 7 SUITABILITY 7 CONTRADICTION yes OVERALL 5 — Contradictory setup (forgot umbrella vs sudden downpour) and weak causal link for beat 1 target word usage
PLAN D: CAUSAL 9 CHRONOLOGY 9 PLAUSIBILITY 10 SIMPLICITY 10 TARGETFIT 10 SUITABILITY 9 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 9 — Excellent causal chain, very natural target word integration, and highly plausible scenario

PLAN E: CAUSAL 8 CHRONOLOGY 6 PLAUSIBILITY 4 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 8 SUITABILITY 7 CONTRADICTION yes OVERALL 6 — Logic error: If the pen is at the desk in beat 1, he should simply go to the office from there; borrowing it and returning it implies complex movement not supported by the setting.
PLAN F: CAUSAL 7 CHRONOLOGY 9 PLAUSIBILITY 5 SIMPLICITY 8 TARGETFIT 7 SUITABILITY 6 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 6 — "Be" usage is awkward for finding an object under a bench; plot relies on a cartoonish coincidence (sitting on the book) rather than a linguistic problem.
PLAN G: CAUSAL 7 CHRONOLOGY 6 PLAUSIBILITY 6 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 7 SUITABILITY 7 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 6 — Timeline confusion in Beat 1 header ("After 1st class") vs content; borrowing a school facility item like a basketball is less natural than personal items.
PLAN H: CAUSAL 8 CHRONOLOGY 7 PLAUSIBILITY 6 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 6 SUITABILITY 7 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 6 — Logic flaw: "If the cup isn't clean, she won't lend it" is a weird condition for lending; usually one washes it or doesn't lend it at all, making the dialogue unnatural for HSK 3.
